            "statement": "On 2026-09-27 backend/services/party-directory became an executable independent core runtime.             "id": "FACT-20260925-013-031",
            "revision": 1,
            "status": "accepted",
            "statement": "On 2026-09-27 Party Directory and Project Workspace were verified in the local D1 profile behind the fixed Nginx to Gateway to IAM chain with separate PostgreSQL databases and no direct host exposure. Project exchanged its workload identity for a request-bound credential limited to audience party-directory, action party-directory.reference.read and the exact party resource; Party recorded and enforced the final authorization. Stopping Party made new Party-dependent Project commands fail without partial writes, while existing Project snapshots remained readable and Project creation without Party continued. After recovery, a new command succeeded exactly once. Combined backup 20260927T025800Z and destructive empty-target restore preserved 2 Party records, 4 Project records and 3 Project client-party snapshots plus IAM signing material, and the full non-disruptive acceptance passed again. This establishes only the local D1 API, authorization, failure and recovery boundary; Party management/Project customer-selection UI, Contract/Money migration, complete dual-tenant testing and real Ubuntu/public deployment remain unproven.",
            "basis": "Static assembly gates, formal-chain API assertions, IAM audit and exact-scope behavior, live service disruption, database no-partial-write checks, combined backup metadata, destructive restore counts, post-restore writes and repository-wide tests agree on the bounded D1 claim.",

            "statement": "Billing's minimum protected HTTP user boundary is realized for create, detail and history. The HTTP layer strips untrusted identity headers, invokes the native IAM Provider, requires the endpoint-native Capability, and makes Billing's final Tenant and resource-scope decision. Tenant Scope may create; Project Scope creation requires at least one Project source and every Project source in the request must be authorized. Detail and history accept only the caller Tenant and exact invoice or matching Project scope. Current and historical amounts are server-redacted unless billing-invoice.amount.read is present. A real PostgreSQL integration test composes Ed25519 IAM credentials, the typed Party/Project resolver, domain service, migration and store; adjacent role, Project B, cross-Tenant, forged identity, wrong source state and dependency failure close safely. A 503 source failure writes zero registrations, revisions, commands and audits; recovery with the same Command writes exactly once; later successful replay does not revisit the failed dependency. This fact is limited to create/detail/history and does not claim list, mutation, Evidence management, formal IAM/Policy issuance, runnable process, Gateway/Nginx, browser, D1, recovery or C3 completion.",
